items.title: Data manipulations alleged in study that paved way for Microsoft's quantum chip
items.title_zh: 微软量子芯片奠基研究被指数据操纵
items.summary: A Science report alleges data manipulation in the study that paved the way for Microsoft's quantum chip.

items.title: Databricks in talks to acquire startup Neon for about $1B
items.raw_content: An Upstarts paid subscriber special edition: acquisition-hungry data and AI unicorn Databricks is in advanced talks to buy the startup behind a popular open-source version of Postgres, sources say.
items.title_zh: Databricks 洽谈以约 10 亿美元收购初创公司 Neon
items.summary: Databricks is in advanced talks to buy Neon, the company behind a widely used open-source Postgres variant, per Upstarts, which cites sources. The reported price is about $1 billion.

items.title: Gemini 2.5 Pro Preview
items.raw_content: Explore the new Gemini 2.5 Pro I/O Edition, featuring enhanced coding performance, video to code capabilities, and improvements for front-end web development.
items.title_zh: Gemini 2.5 Pro 预览版
items.summary: A Google developer blog post introduces the Gemini 2.5 Pro I/O Edition, citing enhanced coding performance, video-to-code capabilities, and improvements for front-end web development.

items.title: NVIDIA CEO says China’s AI chip market could reach $50 billion, vital for US companies
items.raw_content: NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang told CNBC on Tuesday that China’s AI chip market could reach $50 billion in the coming years, making it crucial for US companies
items.title_zh: 英伟达 CEO：中国 AI 芯片市场规模有望达 500 亿美元，对美国企业至关重要
items.summary: NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang told CNBC that China's market for AI chips may grow to $50 billion within a few years, which he described as important for US companies.

items.title: ByteDance-Seed/Seed1.5-VL
items.raw_content: Seed1.5-VL, a vision-language foundation model designed to advance general-purpose multimodal understanding and reasoning, achieving state-of-the-art performance on 38 out of 60 public benchmarks.  [Lang: Jupyter Notebook]
items.title_zh: ByteDance-Seed/Seed1.5-VL：视觉语言基础模型
items.summary: Seed1.5-VL is a ByteDance vision-language foundation model aimed at general-purpose multimodal understanding and reasoning, reporting state-of-the-art results on 38 of 60 public benchmarks.

items.title: Data manipulations alleged in study that paved way for Microsoft's quantum chip
items.title_zh: 微软量子芯片奠基研究被指数据操纵
items.summary: A Science report alleges data manipulation in the study that paved the way for Microsoft's quantum chip.

items.title: Databricks in talks to acquire startup Neon for about $1B
items.title_zh: Databricks 洽谈以约 10 亿美元收购初创公司 Neon
items.summary: Databricks is in advanced talks to buy Neon, the company behind a widely used open-source Postgres variant, per Upstarts, which cites sources. The reported price is about $1 billion.

items.title: Gemini 2.5 Pro Preview
items.title_zh: Gemini 2.5 Pro 预览版
items.summary: A Google developer blog post introduces the Gemini 2.5 Pro I/O Edition, citing enhanced coding performance, video-to-code capabilities, and improvements for front-end web development.

items.title: AI Meets WinDBG
items.title_zh: 当 AI 遇上 WinDBG
items.summary: The post shows how AI-assisted debugging can outperform manual work in WinDBG's command line, such as avoiding the need to squint at hex dumps.

items.title: Replacing Kubernetes with systemd (2024)
items.title_zh: 用 systemd 取代 Kubernetes（2024）
items.summary: The author recounts overusing Kubernetes and argues that systemd can handle most of what he relied on it for.

items.title: Accents in latent spaces: How AI hears accent strength in English
items.title_zh: 潜空间里的口音：AI 如何判断英语口音的浓重程度
items.summary: BoldVoice, an AI accent-coaching app, describes how it derives an “accent fingerprint” embedding from English speech recordings using its large-scale accented speech model, as a step toward having machines judge how strong an accent is.

items.title: New studies offer insight into Lyme disease’s treatment, lingering symptoms
items.title_zh: 新研究揭示莱姆病的治疗与持续症状
items.summary: Two Northwestern studies led by bacteriologist Brandon L. Jutras identified an antibiotic that cures Lyme disease at a fraction of the dosage of the current gold-standard treatment and found what may cause a treated infection to mimic chronic illness.

items.title: Jury orders NSO to pay $167M for hacking WhatsApp users
items.title_zh: 陪审团裁定 NSO 因入侵 WhatsApp 用户赔偿 1.67 亿美元
items.summary: A jury ordered NSO Group to pay $167 million for hacking WhatsApp users, a verdict Ars Technica frames as a major win for critics of the exploit trade.

items.title: A flat pricing subscription for Claude Code
items.title_zh: Claude Code 纳入统一订阅，采用固定价格
items.summary: Anthropic's support documentation says individual Pro, Max and Ultra subscribers can use Claude Code in the terminal or a supported IDE under the same subscription as Claude on web, desktop and mobile.

items.title: Reservoir Sampling
items.title_zh: 蓄水池抽样：在不知总量时如何公平选择
items.summary: An illustrated article explains reservoir sampling, a technique for picking a fair random sample when the total number of items to choose from is unknown in advance.

items.title: CryptPad: An Alternative to the Google Suite
items.title_zh: CryptPad：Google 套件的替代方案
items.summary: CryptPad is an open-source, end-to-end encrypted collaborative office suite positioned as an alternative to Google's productivity tools.

items.title: Starlink User Terminal Teardown
items.title_zh: Starlink 用户终端拆解
items.summary: A teardown of a Starlink user terminal examines the hardware that connects users to SpaceX's low Earth orbit satellite internet service.

items.title: Failed Soviet Venus lander Kosmos 482 crashes to Earth after 53 years in orbit
items.title_zh: 失败的苏联金星着陆器 Kosmos 482 在轨 53 年后坠回地球
items.summary: The Soviet Union's failed Kosmos 482 Venus lander fell back to Earth on May 10, ending a five-decade journey, Space.com reports.

items.title: WebGL Water (2010)
items.title_zh: WebGL 水面模拟演示（2010）
items.summary: A WebGL water demo from 2010 that requires a capable graphics card and up-to-date drivers, with a YouTube video offered for visitors who cannot run it.

items.title: In 2025, venture capital can't pretend everything is fine any more
items.title_zh: 2025 年，风险投资再也无法假装一切安好
items.summary: A Pivot to AI commentary argues that in 2025 the venture capital industry can no longer pretend that everything is fine.

items.title: Why are coffee stains darker at the edges?
items.title_zh: 为什么咖啡渍的边缘更深？
items.summary: The article explains why dried coffee stains are darker at the edges and lighter in the center, starting from a familiar everyday observation.

items.title: Mycoria is an open and secure overlay network that connects all participants
items.title_zh: Mycoria：连接所有参与者的开放安全覆盖网络
items.summary: Mycoria is described as an open and secure overlay network that connects all participants, values freedom of connectivity and aims to capture the curious, adventurous spirit of the early Internet.

items.title: Embracer Games Archive is preserving 75000 video games and needs contributions
items.title_zh: Embracer 游戏档案馆保存 7.5 万款游戏，并寻求更多贡献
items.summary: The Embracer Games Archive says it holds more than 90,000 items in its effort to preserve video game history and is seeking contributions while still in the early stages of the project.

items.title: NVIDIA CEO says China’s AI chip market could reach $50 billion, vital for US companies
items.title_zh: 英伟达 CEO：中国 AI 芯片市场规模有望达 500 亿美元，对美国企业至关重要
items.summary: NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang told CNBC that China's market for AI chips may grow to $50 billion within a few years, which he described as important for US companies.

items.title: Asia’s Global Launchpad: BEYOND BGlobal Summit Connects Startups with Capital and Corporates [New Speakers and Topics Announced!]
items.title_zh: 亚洲的全球发射台：BEYOND BGlobal 峰会连接初创企业、资本与企业
items.summary: The BGlobal Summit is set to launch at BEYOND Expo 2025 on May 22 as an event connecting startups and scale-ups with capital and corporates. Organizers announced new speakers and topics.

items.title: Ele.me hits 10 million daily orders as Alibaba steps up instant delivery push
items.title_zh: 饿了么日订单突破 1000 万，阿里加码即时配送
items.summary: Alibaba’s food delivery platform Ele.me said on May 5 that it had surpassed 10 million daily orders through its Taobao Flash Buy service, which it described as its highest level.

items.title: Xiaomi sets up Xring division to develop in-house chip, led by former Qualcomm executive
items.title_zh: 小米成立 Xring 部门自研芯片，由前高通高管领导
items.summary: Xiaomi has established a new division called Xring to develop its first custom system-on-chip, after a long history of attempts to enter the chip field.

items.title: China’s Pony.ai sees shares surge after Uber deal, as truly autonomous cars move closer to reality
items.title_zh: Pony.ai 与 Uber 达成合作后股价大涨，自动驾驶加速走向现实
items.summary: Pony.ai's shares rose after a deal with Uber, marking the third time in a week that Uber has partnered with a Chinese company and suggesting better sentiment toward autonomous vehicle firms.

items.title: DeepSeek credits Tencent for major performance boost in open-source framework DeepEP
items.title_zh: DeepSeek 致谢腾讯：开源框架 DeepEP 性能大幅提升
items.summary: Tencent's technical team optimized DeepSeek's open-source DeepEP communication framework, improving its performance across different network environments in a contribution DeepSeek is crediting.

items.title: Lenovo debuts humanoid robot LeXiang No.1, pushing into embodied intelligence and AI
items.title_zh: 联想发布首款人形机器人 LeXiang No.1，进军具身智能
items.summary: At its Tech World 2025 event in Shanghai, Lenovo unveiled its first humanoid robot, LeXiang No.1, calling it a "silicon employee" and signalling its entry into embodied intelligence and AI.

items.title: Alibaba CEO urges re-entrepreneurship as company bets big on AI and core battles
items.title_zh: 阿里巴巴 CEO 呼吁“重新创业”，公司押注 AI 与核心业务
items.summary: Alibaba CEO Eddie Wu urged employees to "start over" with a founder's mindset as the company enters an era driven by AI, according to an internal post.

items.title: Trump’s new tariffs on Bosch China would have a “fairly small” impact, president says
items.title_zh: 博世中国称特朗普新关税影响“相当小”
items.summary: Bosch China's president said new Trump tariffs would have a fairly small impact, while China's rare-earth export controls are temporarily affecting the company because the materials are essential for electric motors.

items.title: iPhone Pro now eligible for China’s national subsidy program
items.title_zh: iPhone Pro 现已符合中国国家补贴计划资格
items.summary: Apple cut prices for all storage variants of the iPhone 16 Pro and Pro Max in China, making the models eligible for the country's national subsidy program.

items.title: ByteDance-Seed/Seed1.5-VL
items.title_zh: ByteDance-Seed/Seed1.5-VL：视觉语言基础模型
items.summary: Seed1.5-VL is a ByteDance vision-language foundation model aimed at general-purpose multimodal understanding and reasoning, reporting state-of-the-art results on 38 of 60 public benchmarks.

items.title: AkiraBit/PicSharp
items.title_zh: AkiraBit/PicSharp：跨平台图像压缩工具
items.summary: PicSharp is an image compression app written in TypeScript, with a modern interface, broad features and support for multiple platforms.

items.title: browser-use/workflow-use
items.title_zh: browser-use/workflow-use——创建并运行工作流
items.summary: Workflow-use is a Python project for creating and running workflows, described on GitHub as “RPA 2.0”.

items.title: bazaar-org/bazaar
items.title_zh: bazaar-org/bazaar：项目已迁移至 GNOME GitLab
items.summary: The Bazaar repository has moved to GNOME's GitLab instance, and the GitHub page now only points to the new location.

items.title: glebkudr/shotgun_code
items.title_zh: shotgun_code：为 LLM 工作流一键“炸开”代码库
items.summary: A Go utility that performs a one-click codebase "blast" aimed at large language model workflows.

items.title: operacle/checkcle
items.title_zh: operacle/checkcle：自托管开源监控平台
items.summary: CheckCle is a self-hosted, open-source monitoring platform offering real-time uptime checks, distributed monitoring, incident tracking, and alerts for full-stack systems.

items.title: xob0t/gotohp
items.title_zh: gotohp：非官方 Google Photos 桌面客户端
items.summary: Gotohp is an unofficial desktop GUI client for Google Photos, implemented in Go.

items.title: scaledown-team/scaledown
items.title_zh: scaledown-team/scaledown：Python 项目
items.summary: Scaledown is a Python project published by the scaledown-team on GitHub; the available description contains no further detail.

items.title: chungmin99/pyroki
items.title_zh: chungmin99/pyroki——模块化机器人运动学优化工具包
items.summary: Pyroki is described on GitHub as a modular toolkit for robot kinematic optimization, written in Python.

items.title: openconstruct/Peersuite
items.title_zh: Peersuite：点对点工作空间
items.summary: Peersuite is a peer-to-peer workspace project written in JavaScript.

items.title: Extending Decision Predicate Graphs for Comprehensive Explanation of Isolation Forest
items.title_zh: 扩展决策谓词图，全面解释 Isolation Forest
items.summary: The paper proposes a global explainability method for Isolation Forest outlier detection built on Decision Predicate Graphs, plus an Inlier-Outlier Propagation Score showing how samples are identified as outliers.

items.title: 34 Examples of LLM Applications in Materials Science and Chemistry: Towards Automation, Assistants, Agents, and Accelerated Scientific Discovery
items.title_zh: 材料科学与化学中 LLM 应用的 34 个案例：迈向自动化、助手、智能体与加速科学发现
items.summary: The paper reviews 34 projects from the second annual LLM hackathon on applications in materials science and chemistry, spanning seven areas from property prediction and materials design to automation and knowledge extraction. It argues LLMs serve as versatile predictive models and rapid-prototyping platforms, while flagging reliability, interpretability and reproducibility challenges.

items.title: Quiet Feature Learning in Algorithmic Tasks
items.title_zh: 算法任务中的静默特征学习
items.summary: Training Transformer language models on ten algorithmic tasks, the authors observe phase transitions in loss curves and find that “quiet features” encoding intermediate computations are learned before task loss drops, with ablation experiments showing they are causally necessary.

items.title: InstanceGen: Image Generation with Instance-level Instructions
items.title_zh: InstanceGen：基于实例级指令的图像生成
items.summary: InstanceGen couples image-based structural guidance with LLM-based instance-level instructions, producing images that follow prompts covering object counts, instance attributes and spatial relations between instances.

items.title: Boltzmann Classifier: A Thermodynamic-Inspired Approach to Supervised Learning
items.title_zh: 玻尔兹曼分类器：受热力学启发的监督学习新方法
items.summary: The authors propose a Boltzmann classifier, a distance-based probabilistic method inspired by the Boltzmann distribution, reporting results competitive with or better than logistic regression, SVMs, random forests, and k-nearest neighbors on molecular, chemistry, and breast cancer tasks.

items.title: Triangulating PL functions and the existence of efficient ReLU DNNs
items.title_zh: 分段线性函数的三角剖分与高效 ReLU 神经网络的存在性
items.summary: The paper shows that every compactly supported piecewise linear function can be represented as a sum of simplex functions, yielding a short elementary proof that efficient universal ReLU neural networks exist for all such functions of bounded complexity.

items.title: A New Perspective To Understanding Multi-resolution Hash Encoding For Neural Fields
items.title_zh: 理解神经场多分辨率哈希编码的新视角
items.summary: The paper proposes a "domain manipulation" perspective to explain how Instant-NGP's multi-resolution hash grid learns target signals and boosts the expressivity of neural fields. Experiments on carefully constructed 1D signals support the explanation, and the authors argue it generalizes to higher dimensions.
